name: Мат у два ходи (1)
description:
Ultimately, the goal of the game is to mate the enemy king. Therefore, it is important that you become familiar with mating patterns. These are specific configurations in which pieces work together in such a way that the enemy king is in check while all escape spaces are taken away. 

In these lessons we will be working on “mate in two”. Hence there is a sequence of moves available that allows you to forcefully checkmate the enemy king in two moves. 

What do you have to do?

Checkmate the opponent's king. You may use up to two moves for this purpose.

examples.text: The white king is vulnerable. Black has forced checkmate with 1...Qd3+! 2.Ke1 Rg1#
